speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: Our approach combines global expertise, technical safeguards, legal protections and ongoing oversight to ensure that citizen data remains secure.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: We continuously monitor vendor compliance, conduct regular security assessments and update our frameworks to address emerging risks and maintain public trust.

speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre (Non-Constituency Member)
text: I am not sure if the Minister of State is at the liberty to disclose if we do have any ongoing contracts with Palantir, but I think even if the answer is no, the broader concern remains that overseas legislation like the United States' Clarifying Lawful Overseas Use of Data (CLOUD) Act compels these US-based companies to disclose data in their legal system from foreign countries.

speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre (Non-Constituency Member)
text: Even with data residency in mind, the Act still compels them to disclose this data.

speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre (Non-Constituency Member)
text: What assurances can the Minister of State give that we will not be subject to such compulsions?

speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
text: I understand that the Member may have filed a separate Parliamentary Question on Palantir for the Ministry of Finance (MOF), which I will leave for MOF to answer.
